info.title: Datalith API
info.description: A media store that runs as one instance, with file contents on disk and metadata in SQLite. IDs are UUID strings. Dates are UTC RFC 3339 strings. File sizes and page totals are decimal strings. A trusted backend or reverse proxy must handle authentication. This release does not include audio or video conversion or a new Node.js client.

post.description: The service saves the upload and task before it responds. It does not wait for image conversion. Without options, it creates a permanent resource. The upload is streamed to disk.

post.description: Export pauses content writes, file cleanup, and single-use downloads. Normal downloads continue. The archive contains a versioned manifest and one copy of each file content.

post.description: Import keeps IDs where possible and skips matching items. An ID used by different data is replaced with a new ID. The result includes the old-to-new ID maps. Importing the same archive again does not create duplicates.

get.summary: Read supported media types, limits, and planned output formats

200.description: Read supported media types, limits, and planned output formats

X-Request-Id.description: Request ID created by the server.

MediaKind.description: Audio and video are planned for a future release. Both currently return 415.

expires_in_seconds.description: For new uploads, the lifetime starts when processing is complete and the media is saved. Processing an existing source keeps its original expiry time.

name.description: The name must be unique in this request. The name original is reserved.

multipliers.description: The list must include 1. Each value must be at most capabilities.image.limits.max_multiplier.

ImageOptions.description: SVG and SVGZ use a renderer that does not load external images. SVG XML and embedded data share a 64 MiB limit, with at most 32 nested SVG images. SVGZ originals keep their compressed bytes and use application/gzip.

ProcessOptions.description: The original file must be available for a new task. A repeated request with the same idempotency key, source ID, and options returns the existing task even after the source is deleted or expires. A single-use source returns 409. The result keeps the source expiry time and is not saved if that time has passed.

file_size.description: A decimal string that JavaScript can read with BigInt.

content_path.description: A relative URL for this variant, multiplier, and format.

total.description: A decimal string that JavaScript can read with BigInt.

attempt.description: Number of times processing has started. This is zero before the first attempt.

result.description: Upload and image tasks return Media. Export tasks return ExportResult. Import tasks return ImportResult.

max_file_size.description: A decimal string that JavaScript can read with BigInt.

Error.description: An error object with a code and message. Writes paused by an export return 503 with Retry-After: 1.

X-Request-Id.description: Request ID created by the server.
